name: Campingplatz Maier Schwoich
beschreibung:
Situated quietly on the sunny plateau of Schwoich, Campingplatz Maier welcomes visitors with authentic Tyrolean hospitality. This family-run site features well-kept pitches, modern sanitary facilities, and splendid panoramic views of the Wilder Kaiser range.

Nearby walking trails, refreshing swimming lakes, and the historic fortress town of Kufstein provide varied leisure opportunities for guests of all ages.
kurzbeschreibung: Campingplatz Maier in Schwoich offers rural charm in the Kufsteinerland region at the foot of the Kaiser mountains.
